magicTouch.title: Magic Touch
magicTouch.subtitle: Letters fall from the sky. Sign the first letter to pop each target.
magicTouch.readyBody: Targets fall from the top. The first letter in each target is the sign to make.
magicTouch.startRound: Start the round. Falling targets pop when your hand sign matches their first letter.
magicTouch.startHint: Sign the first letter of the lowest falling target.

magicTouch.noMatchingTarget: Detected {{letter}}, but no falling target starts with that letter right now.
magicTouch.gameOver: Game over. Save or restart your round.
